sections.title: Form and habitat
sections.text: A small spring herb, 5–15 cm tall, of damp, shaded woodland across the temperate Northern Hemisphere. Its leaves are divided; the stem bears a compact, almost cube-shaped cluster of five greenish flowers, followed by fleshy fruits.

sections.title: Food and safety
sections.text: The sources consulted do not establish whether this plant is edible or toxic.
